# printf

Format arguments as text or bytes through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/printf '%s: %04d\n' item 7

moonx cli/printf '%s\n' first second
```

Reuse the format while arguments remain. Backslash escapes, numeric formatting and shell-quoted output are supported.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Numeric formatting uses the fixed Linux amd64 extended-precision profile. Locale-specific formatting is unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
